meta.name: ss-resolve
meta.description: Compile a small, deterministic StyleSeed rule bundle for one agent, output grammar, surface adapter, domain, page type, and optional profile. Use before setup or build, when STYLESEED.md changes, when updating StyleSeed, or whenever an agent would otherwise load the full rule handbook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在构建前为单个代理准备精简 StyleSeed 规则包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望规则变更时生成精简包而非加载全套手册
copy.tagline_en: Compile a small StyleSeed rule bundle for one agent before building
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a lean rule set instead of loading the full handbook

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会运行脚本把 STYLESEED.md 编译成精简 StyleSeed 规则包,生成 effective-rules.md 等文件,供构建前使用,不再加载完整规则手册。
howto.when: 在构建或设置前、STYLESEED.md 有变化、更新 StyleSeed 时,或 agent 原本会加载完整规则手册时触发。

say.text: 帮我解析 STYLESEED.md,生成规则包。
用 --check 检查规则有没有漂移。
把配置解析成 dashboard 页面类型。
say.note: 会按指定参数生成规则束。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude runs the resolve-context script to compile STYLESEED.md into a small deterministic StyleSeed rule bundle (grammar, surface adapter, domain, page type, optional profile), writes it under .styleseed/, and uses it instead of the full rule handbook.
howto.when_en: Triggered before setup or build, when STYLESEED.md changes, when updating StyleSeed, or whenever the agent would otherwise load the full rule handbook.

say_en.text: Parse STYLESEED.md and generate the rule bundle.
Resolve a dashboard bundle for claude.
